description: This file defines a security-related module for sanitizing and inspecting environment variable overrides within a host environment. It includes data structures, such as 'HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics', and a key 'HostEnvSanitizer' with methods to analyze, normalize, and filter environment variable overrides based on security policies. The code references external security policy JSON, performs string and prefix checks, and processes environment variables in the context of security restrictions.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A data structure that holds lists of blocked and invalid environment variable keys identified during inspection.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Analyzes a given set of environment variable overrides to identify which are blocked or invalid based on security policies.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Returns a sanitized environment variable dictionary, filtering out blocked variables and applying optional override filtering for shell wrappers.
